headline: Sales expanded year over year
evidence: Total sales in 2025 were 23.4% higher than in 2024.
recommended_action: Prioritize capacity and inventory planning for continued growth; validate whether the increase is sustainable with 2026 data.

headline: North is the leading region
evidence: North contributed 29.5% of total sales and generated the highest regional revenue.
recommended_action: Protect the strongest region while testing which practices can be replicated in lower-performing regions.

headline: Electronics is the largest category
evidence: Electronics represented 43.1% of sales, the largest category contribution.
recommended_action: Maintain availability of top-selling products and review category-level margin before expanding promotions.

headline: Sales are seasonal
evidence: October–December accounted for 30.1% of all sales; the strongest month was 2025-12.
recommended_action: Plan stock, staffing, and campaign budgets ahead of the fourth-quarter demand period.

headline: East region has a margin opportunity
evidence: East recorded a 15.7% profit margin, the lowest among the four regions.
recommended_action: Review discounting, product mix, logistics, and acquisition costs in East before increasing sales volume.
